en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: I asked Abu Abdullah (Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq), peace be upon him: "What about what these people collect as khums from the lands of jizya and what they take from the dahahin (landowners) as the poll tax (jizya) on their persons? Is there a fixed obligation upon them in this regard?"

Imam (as) replied: "They are bound by what they agreed upon for themselves. The Imam is entitled to no more than the jizya. If the Imam wishes, he may impose it on their persons, leaving their wealth untouched. Alternatively, if he wishes, he may impose it on their wealth, exempting their persons.
As for this khums, it is only something that the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, made a treaty with them concerning."
